export_test.question: Can a new vendor or agent resume the operating memory without Slack history or hidden model memory?

decisions.summary: Usage-based billing copy must mention approval prompts before background agent spend.
Escalate enterprise SSO failures to support owner before asking customers to rerun setup.

active_constraints.summary: Do not export raw Slack threads, private DMs, support tickets, or customer secrets into the target agent.
Any pricing or account-policy claim older than 14 days must be marked stale and reviewed before action.

exceptions.summary: Pilot onboarding may use experimental copy for five named accounts only.

omitted_gaps.reason: Contains customer-identifying support details; only the decision hash and summary were exported.
omitted_gaps.resume_instruction: Ask owner:security for a scoped redacted excerpt before changing related policy.
